scope: 48 timed c1/c64 cohorts, four F/R/R/F repeats and 10-second windows. Correctness smoke excluded. Pooled QPS = sum calls / sum observed cohort elapsed, separately by concurrency/API/role; pooled mean = sum whole-call latency / sum count. Original per-repeat p99 intervals retained; no averaged quantile, significance, no-regression, equal-durability or sustained-capacity claim. No repeats discarded.
